calls.bash: dispatch() { mu task claim "$1" -w eval --for "$2" && mu agent send "$2" -w eval "do $1 and finish with the CLOSE block"; }; TASKS="h1 h2"; i=0; for t in $TASKS; do i=$((i+1)); dispatch $t w$i; done

out=$(mu agent wait w1 w2 -w eval --after-runs 0 --json --timeout 120); ev=$(printf '%s' "$out" | grep -o "eval: h1.sh exit 0 run=[0-9a-f]*" | head -1); mu task close h1 -w eval --evidence "$ev"; mu task close h2 -w eval --evidence "$ev"; printf "h1: $ev\nh2: $ev\n" > summary.md

text: h1 and h2 were done by their workers; summary.md has their evidence.
